desc:
🏎️ Welcome to Race Cars! 🏁

Build your garage, unbox your own cars, and race them for cash!
An idle RNG racing game where your Garage keeps earning even offline!

How to Play:
🍀 Buy Crates and get cool Cars
🚗 A new race every minute
🏆 All cars have a random chance of winning but better cars earn more!
✨ Hunt ultra-rare 1-in-[X] traits and car combinations
🥰 Clean your cars for extra XP bonus
🏠 Upgrade your garage to earn faster 

Remember, your cars keep earning while you're offline ⭐

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
